affected_component: portable_workspace_runtime golden_file_identity/golden_tree_sha256 (single stdlib ruler) → assembler test prelude _golden_sha V2, preflight golden check, fresh-audit reference match, reproducibility probe
invariant: Acceptance equality of a delivered workspace is the golden identity: per file, bytes that parse as a zip archive are identified by their sorted (member name, member bytes) pairs — member ordering, compression level, entry timestamps and extra fields never decide a comparison — and every other file by its raw sha256; the tree identity binds path and executable bit to that. The exported public-test prelude implements the identical algorithm (parity test), and the four Core equality sites (preflight golden, fresh-audit reference match, reproducibility probe, public-test _golden_sha) use it. Evidence manifests keep the raw tree_sha256 for integrity, so frozen packages' manifest hashes are untouched; already-frozen tasks keep their old prelude and only re-frozen versions gain the ruler.
